description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crookshank Kobolds.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Crookshank Kobolds dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand.
Repeat.
